title: AI Engineer
reason: Stack +65; Synergy +20; Title fit +12; Entry +15; US +10; Overqualified -45
description_preview:
About The Company
Capital One is a leading financial services company dedicated to transforming the banking experience through innovative technology and responsible AI practices. With a strong focus on leveraging machine learning and artificial intelligence, Capital One has established itself as an industry pioneer in delivering personalized, real-time customer solutions. The company’s commitment to technological excellence is reflected in its substantial investments in infrastructure, talent, and research, enabling it to develop scalable and high-performance AI systems. Capital One aims to redefine banking by making financial services more accessible, efficient, and human-centric, ensuring that customers receive the best possible experience while maintaining the highest standards of security and compliance.
About The Role
As a Senior Lead AI Engineer specializing in AI Foundations, LLM Core, and Agentic AI, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of AI at Capital One. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge AI solutions that transform how the bank interacts with its customers and streamlines its operations. Your expertise will contribute to building foundational AI systems, optimizing large language models, and implementing responsible AI practices. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation, applying state-of-the-art techniques to real-world banking challenges, and influencing the long-term technological vision of the organization.
Qualifications
The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical foundation combined with leadership experience in AI and software engineering. A minimum of 6 years of experience in developing AI and machine learning algorithms is required, with a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, or related fields. A master’s degree with at least 4 years of relevant experience is also acceptable. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Go, Scala, or Java is essential. Preferred qualifications include 7+ years of experience deploying scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms like AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure, along with demonstrated leadership in managing engineering teams and influencing cross-functional stakeholders. Deep knowledge of AI system optimization, LLM inference, vector databases, and responsible AI practices will be highly advantageous.
Responsibilities
Partner with multidisciplinary teams including engineers, research scientists, product managers, and program managers to deliver innovative AI-powered products that enhance customer engagement and operational efficiency.
Design, develop, test, and support AI software components such as foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, evaluation, and observability frameworks.
Leverage a diverse stack of open-source and SaaS AI technologies including AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, Nemo Guardrails, and PyTorch to build scalable AI solutions.
Invent and implement advanced optimization techniques for large-scale LLMs to improve performance metrics such as scalability, latency, throughput, and cost-efficiency.
Contribute to the technical vision and strategic roadmap for foundational AI systems, ensuring alignment with business goals and responsible AI principles.
Mentor junior engineers, foster innovation, and advocate best practices in AI development and deployment.
Benefits
Capital One offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your overall well-being and professional growth. Employees are eligible for competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and long-term incentives. The company provides health, dental, vision, and wellness programs, along with financial benefits such as retirement plans and employee stock purchase options. Capital One promotes a flexible work environment, ongoing learning opportunities, and a culture of innovation and inclusion. Additionally, employees have access to resources that support work-life balance, personal development, and community engagement. The organization is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and every employee can thrive.
Equal Opportunity
Capital One is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class under applicable law. We promote diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices and workplace policies. Capital One complies with all federal, state, and local laws regarding equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination. We also support reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities and those requiring accommodations during the application process. Our goal is to build a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve and to foster a culture of respect, fairness, and opportunity for everyone.

title: Entry-Level Software Developer
reason: Stack +22; Title fit +12; Poor fit -3; Entry +15; US +10; H1B +8
description_preview:
Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.
Code that saves lives.
As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.
Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.
The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.
Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.
Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).
More than just important work
.
Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.
We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.
Relocation to the Madison, WI area (Reimbursed)
BS/BA or greater in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
A history of academic excellence or professional success
Eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship (persons with appropriate qualifications and eligible for TN status under NAFTA may apply)
COVID-19 vaccination

Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.
Code that saves lives.
As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.
Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.
The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.
Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.
Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).
More than just important work
.
Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.
We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.
Relocation to the Madison, WI area (Reimbursed)
BS/BA or greater in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
A history of academic excellence or professional success
Eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship (persons with appropriate qualifications and eligible for TN status under NAFTA may apply)
COVID-19 vaccination

Senior / Staff Software Engineer (C++ and Systems)
Confidential client. Search led by VoltForce.
Location: San Leandro, CA (on-site) Job Type: Full-time
About The Company
VoltForce is working with an early-stage materials-inspection company on the search for a Senior or Staff Software Engineer. Our client helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro- and nano-scale materials, the building blocks of critical sectors like energy storage, semiconductors, aerospace, and power systems. As demand surges and production grows more complex and faster, small undetected variations during manufacturing lead to waste, lower performance, higher cost, and safety risk, leaving manufacturers with little visibility into the quality of what they produce.
The company's platform changes that. It non-destructively probes materials during production, pairing a novel sensing approach with physics-informed machine learning to capture real-time signals that conventional measurement techniques cannot access. Those signals give manufacturers rare visibility into how materials behave as they are made.
The company turns that hidden data into actionable intelligence, helping manufacturers reduce variability and increase yield and performance. The platform can run as a standalone tool or integrate directly into production lines, it is already in early deployment with leading global manufacturers, and the first commercial product is on the way.
Role Overview
Our client is seeking a Senior or Staff Software Engineer to design and build the high-performance, systems-level software at the core of the company's platform. You will own software components end to end, from architecture and design through implementation, optimization, and release, working close to the operating system and hardware to deliver the performance the product depends on.
Working across software, firmware, and hardware teams, you will develop and optimize modern C++ software for Linux-based systems, design multi-threaded and asynchronous architectures, and debug complex issues that span the software and hardware boundary. This role suits an engineer who takes ownership of their work, writes clean and maintainable code, and enjoys understanding how software interacts with operating systems and hardware to achieve exceptional performance in real customer environments.
What You'll Do
Design, develop, and optimize high-performance software using modern C++ (C++17/20)

Design multi-threaded and asynchronous software architectures
Analyze, profile, and optimize software performance across CPU, memory, storage, networking, and I/O
Read, understand, maintain, and enhance existing Python code used for automation, testing, and data analysis
Collaborate closely with firmware, hardware, and application engineering teams
Participate in software architecture, technical design, and code reviews
Debug complex system-level issues across software and hardware boundaries
Take ownership of software components throughout the product development lifecycle

Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications
Experience designing and developing large-scale commercial software systems
Experience developing and shipping software for commercial products
Experience with scientific instrumentation or data acquisition systems
Experience collaborating with firmware and hardware engineering teams

Directly impact national security by delivering advanced AI capabilities to federal agents and intelligence analysts in the field.

Embed on-site with customers to write and deploy production code for tailored workflows and custom system integrations.
Configure and optimize mission-specific AI agent systems to operate effectively within classified and high-security government environments.
Act as the primary technical bridge, translating field insights and operational requirements back to the core engineering team.
The ideal candidate
Proven experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer or similar technical role within the defense or national security technology sectors.
Versatile full-stack engineering background with a working knowledge of AI/ML agent systems and complex data integrations.
Strong self-direction and willingness to travel, with the ability to obtain or maintain a Top Secret security clearance.

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.

This role is part of the Jobright TNT - the private hiring network connecting top talent with top AI startups like Perplexity, Mercor, Cresta, Suno and 150 more.
This is not a mass job posting. Only select, high-signal candidates are invited to Jobright TNT and recommended directly to hiring teams
Hiring Company: Ventus AI
One-liner: Ventus AI is building the next generation of AI Teammates, specializing in automating complex workflows for enterprises.
Salary: $150K/yr - $220K/yr
Why Join Us:
Role Responsibilities
• Design and build mission-critical infrastructure for agent memory, logging, security, and observability
• Write robust Python (and some TypeScript) to power low-latency, fault-tolerant, agentic workflows that can recover from UI changes and session timeouts
• Build the communication layer that allows AI Teammates to pro-actively flag exceptions and collaborate with humans in real-time
• Own the end-to-end reliability of agents navigating 'messy' legacy software without APIs
• Make key decisions on testing, CI/CD, and monitoring pipelines from scratch
• Work on a platform designed to scale across diverse industries—from Healthcare and Insurance to Finance and beyond
Qualifications
Required
• Proficiency with Python (async, testing, deployment) and modern development tooling is essential
• You have built and maintained production systems end-to-end—from initial architecture to deployment and refactor
• You enjoy ambiguous environments where you are trusted to figure out the 'how' and 'why.'
• You understand the trade-offs in system design and can build systems that are simple yet resilient
• You approach code with a sense of ownership, urgency, and comfort with the 'chaos' of a 0-to-1 startup
Preferred
• Experience with agentic frameworks, browser automation (Playwright/Puppeteer), or web-scraping at scale
• Experience in secure data processing (SOC 2, HIPAA environments)
• Prior startup/founding experience or significant open-source contributions
How can I join Jobright TNT:
If this is your first time applying to a Jobright TNT role, the process works as follows:
1. Apply to your first Jobright TNT role
2. We review your background to determine if you meet the TNT quality bar
3. If qualified, your application is directly recommended to the employer
4. Once accepted into TNT, you may be:
- Invited to apply for other exclusive TNT-only roles
- Invited to private, invite-only hiring events with top startups
You will be notified of your TNT selection result.
PS: All Jobright TNT roles are 100% real, directly hired by top AI startups we partner with, and come with priority review and higher response rates than the normal application queue.
